findings.message: domain.Item.Alt and domain.Item.Label both map to public.items.label
findings.reason: two fields over one column disagree on every write, and reading fills both with the same value
findings.fix: point Alt at another column with orm:"column:<name>", or exclude it with orm:"-"

findings.message: domain.User and domain.Account both map to public.users
findings.reason: one table has one identity, one set of writable columns and one set of relations; two entities over it would disagree about all three
findings.fix: map domain.User to its own table, or remove one of the two entities
